   - Populated both new and legacy fields in [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/src/core/events.ts#L46-L66).
2. **Tests**:
   - Updated assertions in [test/app.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/test/app.test.ts) and [test/adapters.test.ts](file:///C:/avg/w2/r/test/adapters.test.ts) to verify both new and legacy field names.
